info.description: A standard price readers pay. Managed from handle (Publications > Plans and prices). `key` names the plan; each price change is a new row with the same key and the next version, valid from its validFrom date, so past sales keep the price they were sold at. Organisations are NOT sold plans: their contracts are priced by hand per publication (org-management).

key.description: Stable plan name, e.g. nv_month. Shared by all versions of the plan; not unique.

kind.description: period: every edition of the included publications whose cover dates fall in [start, start + duration). single_issue: one chosen edition (exactly one publication).

revenueSplit.description: { "NV": 78, "NVW": 22 } — percent of the price credited to each publication in reports. Must total 100. Empty = suggested from each publication's own price at the time of sale.

active.description: On sale. 'Stop selling' in handle sets this false on every version.

featured.description: Shown on the reader landing page.
